title: Baahubali: The Beginning
overview: A young man discovers his true heritage and fights to free an enslaved kingdom.
hints: A young man grows up in a tribe at the bottom of a massive waterfall.
He falls in love with a rebel warrior who is fighting a tyrannical king.
He manages to climb the waterfall and discovers his true identity.
A famous scene involves him carrying a giant Shiva Lingam on his shoulders.
It ends with an epic battle and a shocking betrayal by a loyal commander named Kattappa.

title: Arjun Reddy
overview: A medical student spirals into self-destruction after his girlfriend is forced to marry another.
hints: A brilliant but aggressive medical student has a massive anger management problem.
He falls deeply in love with a junior in his college.
When she is forced to marry someone else, he spirals into alcoholism and drug abuse.
The protagonist owns an English mastiff dog.
It's a cult classic that was remade in Hindi as 'Kabir Singh'.

title: Eega
overview: A murdered man is reincarnated to avenge his death and protect his love.
hints: A man is murdered by a wealthy industrialist who desires his girlfriend.
The murdered man is reincarnated to seek revenge and protect his love.
He is reborn not as another human, but as a tiny insect.
The villain is slowly driven crazy by this relentless buzzing creature.
The protagonist uses a pair of custom-made micro-goggles and needles as weapons.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
overview: A man who grew up in the middle class discovers he is the son of a billionaire.
hints: A middle-class employee secretly swaps his newborn son with his wealthy boss's son.
The switched child grows up in a middle-class home, facing constant neglect from his father.
He eventually gets a job in his real father's company.
The protagonist uses a stylish boardroom desk feature as a weapon in a fight.
The movie features the massive hit song 'Butta Bomma'.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
overview: A laborer rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate.
hints: A laborer rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate.
He often brushes his hand under his chin in a signature attitude gesture.
He falls in love with a woman named Srivalli.
He forms a bitter rivalry with a ruthless police officer named Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.
The protagonist famously says, 'Thaggedhe Le'.

title: RRR
overview: A fictitious story about two legendary revolutionaries and their journey away from home.
hints: Two men from very different backgrounds become best friends in pre-independence Delhi.
One is a fierce tribal warrior looking for a kidnapped young girl.
The other is a dedicated police officer secretly working against the British.
They eventually discover they are fighting on opposite sides.
The movie features the Oscar-winning song 'Naatu Naatu'.

title: Magadheera
overview: A bike stuntman discovers his past life as a great warrior of a kingdom.
hints: A modern-day stuntman gets flashes of a past life when he touches a specific woman.
400 years ago, he was a brave warrior protecting a princess.
Both he and the princess, along with their enemy, are reincarnated in the present.
There is a famous sequence where the hero fights 100 soldiers alone to protect the princess.
The villain uses a helicopter in the modern-day climax.

title: Bommarillu
overview: A son tries to break free from his overly controlling father to marry the girl he loves.
hints: A young man has his entire life controlled by his over-affectionate and strict father.
He falls in love with a bubbly, free-spirited girl named Hasini.
His father arranges his marriage with another woman.
He asks his father to let his girlfriend stay in their house for a week to win their hearts.
The climax features an emotional breakdown where the son confronts his father about the lack of freedom.

title: Pokiri
overview: A ruthless thug joins a mafia gang, but holds a secret identity.
hints: A ruthless, money-minded goon joins a powerful mafia gang in Hyderabad.
He falls in love with an aerobics instructor who hates his violent nature.
He single-handedly eliminates rival gang members and corrupt cops.
The surprising twist reveals he is actually an undercover IPS officer.
He famously says, 'Evadu kodithe dimma thirigi mind block aypothundo, aade Pandu gaadu.'

title: Geetha Govindam
overview: A young lecturer accidentally creeps out a woman who turns out to be his sister-in-law.
hints: A respectful young lecturer dreams of finding the perfect traditional wife.
He accidentally takes a selfie and accidentally kisses a woman on a bus.
The woman despises him and thinks he is a pervert.
To his horror, he discovers she is the sister of his brother's fiancée.
They try to hide their animosity to ensure the wedding happens smoothly.

title: Rangasthalam
overview: A hearing-impaired man goes to war against a cruel village president.
hints: A hearing-impaired man operates a boat engine in a small village.
The village is controlled by a ruthless, tyrannical President who has ruled for 30 years.
His educated brother returns from Dubai and decides to stand in the local elections.
The brother gets assassinated, prompting the protagonist to seek revenge.
The movie ends with a shocking revelation about who actually orchestrated the murder.

title: Mahanati
overview: The biographical life story of legendary South Indian actress Savitri.
hints: A biopic tracing the life of an iconic South Indian actress.
The story is framed around two journalists trying to understand her life.
She marries a married Tamil actor and director, leading to personal struggles.
She spirals into alcoholism and financial ruin despite her massive fame.
It chronicles the life of the legendary Savitri.

title: Athadu
overview: A hitman assumes the identity of a dead man to hide from the police.
hints: A professional hitman is framed for the murder of a prominent politician.
While escaping on a train, his co-passenger is accidentally killed by police.
The hitman assumes the dead man's identity and goes to his village.
He slowly bonds with the extended family who were expecting their son to return.
The climax reveals the true mastermind who hired the hitman in the first place.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, a bounty hunter encounters a legendary immortal protecting a pregnant woman.
hints: Set in a post-apocalyptic future, a bounty hunter wants to move to a luxurious complex in the sky.
An immortal warrior from the Mahabharata is sworn to protect a pregnant woman.
The woman is carrying the avatar of a supreme deity.
The reigning supreme leader uses a super-serum extracted from pregnant women to try to achieve ultimate power.
The film blends sci-fi with ancient Indian mythology.

title: Jersey
overview: A failed cricketer decides to return to cricket in his late thirties.
hints: A talented but failed cricketer quit the sport ten years ago.
He struggles financially and simply wants to gift a specific team jersey to his young son.
To buy the jersey and regain his son's respect, he decides to return to professional cricket at the age of 36.
Despite a hidden medical condition, he leads his team to victory.
The movie is celebrated for its emotional depth and realistic portrayal of a father-son relationship.

title: Srimanthudu
overview: A multi-millionaire heir adopts a village to earn respect.
hints: A multi-millionaire heir realizes that wealth isn't enough and wants to earn respect.
He travels to a rural village to adopt and develop it.
He secretly falls in love with a woman from the same village who hates his rich background.
He uses a bicycle to commute instead of his luxury cars.
The protagonist single-handedly fights a local politician and his goons to protect his adopted village.

title: Fidaa
overview: An NRI boy comes to India and falls for a village girl.
hints: An NRI boy comes to India for his older brother's wedding.
He falls in love with the bride's younger sister, an independent village girl.
Their relationship suffers due to misunderstandings and the girl's refusal to leave her father.
The heroine is from Banswada in Telangana and speaks with a strong local dialect.
The girl's famous dialogue is 'Badmash, Bakwas, Balishtha'.

title: Arya
overview: A free-spirited student falls for a girl already forced into a relationship.
hints: A free-spirited college student falls in love with a girl at first sight.
The girl is forced to be the girlfriend of the college bully.
The protagonist practices 'one-side love' and constantly annoys the bully.
He helps the couple elope to a remote town to protect them.
He famously asks his love interest to simply 'Feel my love'.

title: Julayi
overview: A smart youth accidentally witnesses a massive bank robbery.
hints: A happy-go-lucky youth believes in making quick, easy money instead of working hard.
He accidentally witnesses a massive bank robbery planned by a highly intelligent criminal.
He helps the police commissioner track down the stolen money and the mastermind.
The protagonist and the villain engage in a battle of wits involving a betting ring.
The hero famously explains the difference between logic and magic.

title: Gabbar Singh
overview: A reckless police officer clashes with a local goon.
hints: A young boy changes his name after being inspired by a famous Bollywood villain.
He grows up to become a reckless but righteous police officer.
He clashes with a local goon who wants to enter politics.
The hero runs a special gang of rowdy constables who wear red bandanas.
The movie is a massive blockbuster remake of the Hindi movie 'Dabangg'.

title: Race Gurram
overview: Two drastically different brothers work against a politician.
hints: Two brothers have completely opposite personalities and constantly fight.
The older brother is a sincere police officer trying to capture a dangerous politician.
The younger brother is carefree and ends up falling in love with a girl who shows no emotions.
When the older brother is attacked, the younger brother creates a fake police force to take revenge.
The climax features a hilarious character named 'Kill Bill Pandey'.

title: Kushi
overview: Two college students with massive egos constantly clash but secretly admire each other.
hints: Two college students with massive egos constantly clash but secretly admire each other.
Misunderstandings keep them apart, even though they study in the same college.
A crucial conflict arises when the hero accidentally sees the heroine’s waist.
They help their respective friends elope and get married against their parents' wishes.
The hero famously searches for the heroine in the rain at a train station complex.

title: Okkadu
overview: A kabaddi player saves a girl from a powerful factionist.
hints: A state-level Kabaddi player travels to a historical city for a match.
He accidentally ends up rescuing a girl from a powerful factionist who wants to forcefully marry her.
He hides the girl in his own house in Hyderabad without his strict police officer father knowing.
The hero physically defeats the villain at the Charminar monument.
He eventually wins the national Kabaddi championship and defeats the factionist once and for all.

title: Dookudu
overview: An undercover cop maintains a massive lie to keep his recovering father happy.
hints: An undercover cop is determined to take down a powerful mafia don hiding abroad.
His father, an honest politician, wakes up from a long coma.
The hero creates elaborate fake setups to make his father believe everything is perfect.
The movie features a hilarious side plot where a greedy house broker is tricked into investing in a fake movie.
It features the famous comedy character 'Padmanabha Simha'.

title: Happy Days
overview: A coming-of-age story of a group of engineering students.
hints: A coming-of-age story that perfectly captures the four-year journey of a group of engineering students.
The group forms strong bonds despite completely different backgrounds and seniors ragging them.
A prominent storyline involves a junior boy falling deeply in love with a beautiful senior girl.
Another boy has a secret crush on a girl from an affluent, strict family.
The film ends with an emotional farewell on their graduation day.

title: Bharat Ane Nenu
overview: An NRI suddenly becomes the Chief Minister of the state.
hints: An NRI returns to India after receiving news of his father's sudden death.
He is unexpectedly forced to take over his father's position to keep the ruling party together.
He implements strict traffic rules, heavy fines, and massive changes to the education system.
Disgusted by the corruption, he publicly resigns and fights a secret political mafia.
The film's tagline, and a repeating phrase, is 'A promise is a promise.'

title: Goodachari
overview: An orphan joins an intelligence agency but is framed for an attack.
hints: An orphan who was raised by an ex-spy dreams of joining India's premier intelligence agency.
He finally gets recruited, but on graduation day, a massive terrorist attack kills the agency's leaders.
He is framed as the mastermind behind the attack and goes on the run.
He discovers a shocking connection between the terrorist group's leader and his own deceased father.
The hero is known by the operative code 'Agent 116'.

title: Sita Ramam
overview: An orphaned Indian army officer receives letters from an anonymous girl.
hints: An orphaned Indian army officer stationed in Kashmir receives hundreds of letters from an anonymous girl.
He tracks her down to Hyderabad and they fall deeply in love.
He is called for a secret mission to cross the border to save a rogue operative.
A young Pakistani student in the present day must deliver his final letter to the mysterious woman.
The heroine's true identity reveals she is a princess.

title: Hi Nanna
overview: A single father's daughter befriends a mysterious woman with amnesia.
hints: A single father in Mumbai tells his young daughter incomplete bedtime stories about her missing mother.
The daughter befriends a woman who recently survived a serious accident and lost her memory.
The woman slowly realizes she has a deeper connection to the little girl and her father.
A crucial flashback reveals a painful sacrifice the woman made for her father’s reputation.
The movie revolves around cystic fibrosis and an emotional family reunion.

title: Nuvvostanante Nenoddantana
overview: An NRI boy tries to win over a village girl's strict brother.
hints: A playful, rich NRI boy falls in love with a traditional village girl during a wedding.
The girl’s strict, overprotective brother hates wealthy city people because of past trauma.
The hero travels to the village and agrees to work as a farmer for an entire season to prove his love.
He must harvest more grain than the local landlord's son to win the brother's approval.
The film marked the directorial debut of Prabhu Deva.

title: Chatrapathi
overview: A displaced refugee rises to become a powerful leader.
hints: A family is violently separated during the evacuation of a coastal town.
A mother searches endlessly for her younger biological son while raising her adopted older son.
The older son becomes a protector of refugees exploited by a local mafia don.
The hero famously issues a warning that if anyone steps into his area, they will be cut into half.
The protagonist kills a cruel villain named Baji Rao.

title: Attarintiki Daredi
overview: A billionaire's grandson tries to reunite his fractured family.
hints: An elderly billionaire regrets a past mistake that tore his family apart.
His grandson promises to bring his estranged aunt back home before his grandfather's 80th birthday.
The hero goes to Hyderabad and secretly poses as a chauffeur for his aunt's family.
He quietly fixes the personal lives of his cousins and saves his aunt's husband from financial ruin.
The climax features a powerful emotional breakdown by the hero at a railway station.

title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
overview: A brilliant but quirky detective stumbles upon a massive dark conspiracy.
hints: A brilliant but eccentric amateur detective sets up an agency in Nellore.
He wears a trench coat, a fedora, and demands people call him an FBI agent.
He accidentally uncovers a massive, horrific religious crime racket.
The villains frame him for a murder he did not commit to stop his investigation.
The hero's assistant is named Sneha, whom he frequently scolds.

title: Indra
overview: A peace-loving man reveals his violent past to save a family in danger.
hints: A taxi driver in Varanasi lives a quiet, helpful life with his family.
A sudden encounter forces his violent past to catch up with him.
Flashbacks reveal he was once a highly respected peace-keeping leader in his drought-stricken region.
He willingly gave up his life and property so that his rival would sign an agreement for a water reservoir.
The hero famously steps off a helicopter and buries a sickle in the ground to claim peace.

title: Ninne Pelladata
overview: A couple struggles to convince their feuding families to let them marry.
hints: A large, happy joint family wants their favorite son to marry a girl of their choice.
He falls in love with an outsider who comes to their city for aviation training.
Her parents originally eloped in their youth, causing a major family rift.
The couple tries to secretly win the hearts of both families to avoid another shocking elopement.
The film features a massive chartbuster song named 'Greeku Veerudu'.

title: Kshana Kshanam
overview: A woman is pursued by criminals after discovering a clue to stolen money.
hints: A massive gang robbery ends with a bag of stolen money being hidden in an unexpected place.
An innocent middle-class working woman accidentally receives a photo booth envelope related to the money.
She is chased by police and a quirky, dangerous gangster who wants the envelope.
She meets a charming thief who accompanies her on a crazy road trip through forests and trains.
This classic road-trip thriller was directed by Ram Gopal Varma.

title: Simhadri
overview: A faithful servant reveals a bloody past to protect his master's granddaughter.
hints: A fiercely loyal adoptive son will do anything for his master's family.
He travels to Kerala to bring his master's estranged granddaughter back home.
The girl suffers from extreme trauma and acts like a child.
A twist reveals the hero has a terrifying past in Kerala where he was a savior of the masses.
The hero takes up an axe to slaughter a massive army of goons led by a don named Bhai Saab.

title: Pelli Choopulu
overview: Two contrasting personalities form an unexpected business partnership.
hints: A lazy engineering graduate and a focused businesswoman meet during an arranged marriage setup.
Due to a mix-up, they get locked in a room together and share their past failed relationships.
They decide not to get married but establish a food truck business together instead.
The food truck is named after the heroine, 'Prashanthi'.
This charming indie film launched the careers of Vijay Deverakonda and Tharun Bhascker.

title: Mirchi
overview: A man attempts to reform a violent rival village family with love.
hints: An architect returns to India and wins the hearts of his fierce rival's violent family.
He teaches the family that a smile and a hug are better than swords and bloodshed.
It is revealed that his own family suffered a tragic massacre due to this endless village rivalry.
He falls in love with a woman whose brother is ironically his biggest enemy.
The tagline of the hero's philosophy is 'Cutout chusi konni konni nammeyali dude.'

title: Arundhati
overview: A woman discovers she is the reincarnation of a warrior who fought a dark sorcerer.
hints: A soon-to-be-married woman visits her native palace and experiences terrifying paranormal events.
She discovers she is the reincarnation of her brave great-grandmother.
Her ancestor sacrificed herself to seal a powerful, shape-shifting evil sorcerer in a tomb.
The sorcerer has escaped and wants revenge against the descendant.
The climax involves the heroine mastering a weapon created from the bones of her predecessor.

title: C/o Kancharapalem
overview: Four unconventional love stories intertwine in a tight-knit neighborhood.
hints: Four different love stories unfold in a small neighborhood in Visakhapatnam.
The stories cover different age groups: childhood, youth, middle age, and old age.
A 50-year-old unmarried attendant falls for an officer from a different state.
A sculptor faces backlash from locals for his relationship with a prostitute.
A brilliant narrative twist reveals that all four stories belong to the same person.

title: Mathu Vadalara
overview: A delivery boy gets entangled in a surreal murder mystery.
hints: A depressed delivery boy gets cheated out of his wages and decides to secretly rob his customers.
During a delivery, he accidentally gets trapped in an apartment with a dead body.
He and his two roommates must safely dispose of the body without getting caught.
A key plot element involves a wildly exaggerated, highly dramatic fictional daily TV serial.
The main characters use sleep-inducing drugs, leading to hilarious hallucinations.

title: Shiva
overview: A college student stands up against a violent local mobster.
hints: A new student enrolls in a university plagued by intense political violence.
He quietly observes the bullying and criminal activities orchestrated by a powerful local mobster.
To protect his friends, he brutally retaliates using a simple bicycle chain.
This creates a massive gang war that shakes the entire city's underworld.
This iconic trendsetting film marked the directorial debut of Ram Gopal Varma.

title: Jathi Ratnalu
overview: Three goofy friends get framed for a major political crime.
hints: Three best friends from Jogipet move to Hyderabad to seek better lives and respect.
The main protagonist falls madly in love with a girl who lives in his apartment complex.
They accidentally stumble into a high-profile corruption scandal involving a minister.
The three friends represent themselves in court in a wildly hilarious and nonsensical trial.
The movie is packed with non-stop chaotic comedy and famous dialogues like 'Shameless fellows'.

title: DJ Tillu
overview: A flashy local DJ gets involved in covering up an accidental murder.
hints: A self-proclaimed 'Local DJ' who dresses flashily falls instantly for a mysterious woman.
The woman accidentally murders her abusive boyfriend in his apartment.
The DJ gets unwillingly dragged into disposing of the body and covering up her crimes.
He constantly blabbers under extreme stress and delivers hilarious, heavily accented monologues.
The hero's iconic dialogue is 'Atluntadhi manathoni'.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.
hints: The story centers on a powerful syndicate leader defending his turf against multiple rival factions.
The protagonist's sudden rise to immense wealth creates a bitter rift with a humiliated police officer.
A massive search operation is launched as the protagonist briefly goes missing, causing chaos among his followers.
The protagonist dresses in a striking traditional goddess costume to perform an intense dance during a local festival.
The high-stakes sequel to the blockbuster red sandalwood smuggling film, carrying the tagline 'The Rule'.

title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
overview: Set in the fictional dystopian city-state of Khansaar, the film follows the friendship between Deva, a tribesman, and Varadha, the prince of Khansaar. When a coup d'état is planned by his father's ministers and his relatives, Varadha enlists Deva's help to become Khansaar's undisputed ruler.
hints: A story about deep loyalty between two childhood friends who find themselves in a violent, militarized society.
The protagonist lives a quiet life as a mechanic to respect his mother's wishes, hiding a dark, violent past.
One friend is a prince who must call upon the other's unmatched combat skills to survive an internal family coup.
The conflicts center around the internal power struggles of three powerful ruling clans in a lawless territory.
Set in the fictional, dark city-state of Khansaar, starring Prabhas as the ultimate warrior Deva.

title: Devara: Part 1
overview: Devara, a fearless man from a coastal region, embarks on a perilous journey into the treacherous world of the sea to safeguard the lives of his people. Unbeknownst to him, his brother Bhaira is plotting a conspiracy against him. As events unfold, Devara passes on his legacy to his mild-mannered and timid son, Varada.
hints: A local leader decides to abandon a highly profitable but illegal trade after realizing its destructive impact on his people.
His moral stance leads to a deadly betrayal by his closest companion in the middle of a deep-sea operation.
The leader's name becomes a symbol of absolute terror, keeping wrongdoers away from the region for years.
A mild-mannered, timid son must pretend to possess his father's fierce courage to protect his family.
NTR Jr. plays a dual role as father and son in this coastal action epic directed by Koratala Siva.

title: Game Changer
overview: Ram, a newly appointed district collector, takes charge in a city in Andhra Pradesh and immediately confronts the deeply entrenched corruption and inefficiency plaguing the government. Determined to bring reforms, he initiates sweeping changes, sparking a fierce conflict with a powerful state Minister.
hints: A young government official is determined to enforce strict rules and integrity in his new posting.
He faces severe political backlash when he targets the deeply entrenched corruption of senior ministers.
A tragic backstory reveals his father was a selfless reformer who was betrayed by his own associates.
The protagonist introduces a cutting-edge electronic monitoring system to prevent manipulation of public votes.
Directed by Shankar and starring Ram Charan, this political action thriller features the high-energy song 'Jaragandi'.

title: Guntur Kaaram
overview: Years after his mother left him and remarried, Ramana is asked to sign documents denying any relations with his mother, but he refuses and demands answer to why his mother left him.
hints: A fiery-tempered protagonist is deeply estranged from his mother, who left him in his childhood.
His mother has since built a powerful political career, and her relatives want the protagonist to legally cut all ties.
He refuses to sign the disownership documents and decides to confront the family to learn the truth about his past.
The protagonist has a signature habit of chewing beedis and is known for his sharp, sarcastic banter.
Directed by Trivikram, this mass entertainer stars Mahesh Babu in Guntur, dancing to 'Kurchi Madathapetti'.

title: Lucky Baskhar
overview: A cash-strapped bank cashier embarks on a risky investment scheme and soon gets drawn into the murky world of money laundering.
hints: A struggling clerk faces constant humiliation at home and work due to his low income.
Desperate for money, he discovers a loophole in his workplace's daily operations to make quick profits.
His investments grow exponentially, drawing him into a massive national financial scandal.
Set against the backdrop of the late 80s and early 90s stock market boom in India.
Dulquer Salmaan plays the titular clever bank cashier who executes a high-risk money-laundering scheme.

title: Major
overview: This biopic follows the life of Indian Army officer Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, from his childhood to his heroic actions during the 2008 Mumbai attacks.
hints: A young man ignores his parents' safety concerns to follow his lifelong dream of serving his nation.
The film chronicles his journey from a spirited schoolboy to a highly trained elite commando officer.
The narrative reaches its peak during a high-stakes counter-terrorist operation inside a besieged luxury hotel.
He famously commands his teammates to stay back, choosing to face the threat alone to save civilian hostages.
Adivi Sesh portrays the real-life hero Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan during the 26/11 Mumbai attacks.

title: Liger
overview: The journey of Liger, from Karimnagar to Mumbai, from a nobody to a competitor, in his search for recognition while navigating his weaknesses, relationships, and love life.
hints: An ambitious fighter relocates to a metropolitan city with his hot-tempered mother to pursue his dreams.
He struggles with a speech impediment, which makes him the target of constant ridicule during press events.
His romantic distraction with a wealthy social media star leads to a devastating setback in his career.
The protagonist travels to the United States and faces a legendary real-world heavyweight boxer in the climax.
Directed by Puri Jagannadh, this MMA sports action film stars Vijay Deverakonda and features a cameo by Mike Tyson.

title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram
overview: Set in Sokulapalem, bound by a promise to his mother, Surya, an LIC agent leads a normal life on six days, maintains a careful ledger of everyone made him angry, unleashing his anger only on Saturdays, solely for justifiable reasons. A tragic incident pits him on a collision course with the ruthless and borderline-manic cop Daya.
hints: A child makes a solemn promise to his dying mother to control his intense anger.
As an adult, he lives a completely ordinary life, but maintains a secret ledger of people who cross him.
He allows himself to act on his accumulated rage and deliver justice only on one specific day of the week.
He goes head-to-head with a manic, abusive police officer who terrorizes an innocent local neighborhood.
Nani plays Surya, a hero who unleashes his physical rage strictly on Saturdays.

title: Tillu Square
overview: The zany crime-comedy sequel to DJ Tillu, where DJ Tillu gets entangled with a mysterious woman, Lily.
hints: A highly confident, fast-talking young man gets infatuated with a woman he meets at a party.
She disappears the next day, only to return later with a shocking claim that forces him into a corner.
He gets dragged into a chaotic web of espionage, intelligence agencies, and international drug cartels.
The protagonist is known for his eccentric dressing style, curly hair, and non-stop funny monologues under stress.
The blockbuster comedy sequel to DJ Tillu, starring Siddhu Jonnalagadda and Anupama Parameswaran.

title: Dasara
overview: Dharani, a young man who steals coal from passing trains, rises to fight against the oppression of local landlords after his best friend is brutally murdered.
hints: The story unfolds in a dusty, rustic village built around a coal mine, where life revolves around a local bar.
A lifelong friendship between two men is tested when they both fall in love with the same local woman.
A brutal crime committed on a wedding night shatters the peace of the village, leaving the protagonist devastated.
The protagonist must overcome his deep fears and severe alcoholism to take revenge against a powerful local leader.
Nani stars as the rugged Dharani, carrying dual sickles in a coal-mine setting.

title: Sarileru Neekevvaru
overview: A tough army major is deployed to Kurnool on a mission to keep the country safe from external threats.
hints: An army officer is tasked with visiting a town to safeguard the family of a fallen comrade.
He discovers that the family is being terrorized and blackmailed by a corrupt, powerful politician.
The officer decides to stay back and protect them, using clever mind games and physical combat to defeat the goons.
A long train journey in the film features a famous comedy track involving a hyperactive family and a recurring dialogue: 'Never before, never after'.
Mahesh Babu plays Major Ajay Krishna in this high-voltage commercial entertainer.

title: Radhe Shyam
overview: Vikramaditya, a world-renowned palmist, believes love does not exist in his stars, until he meets Prerana. But when destiny tries to pull them apart, will love prevail?
hints: A romantic drama set in 1970s Europe, exploring the conflict between predetermined fate and human love.
The protagonist is a mysterious man who is highly sought after by world leaders for his absolute predictions.
He falls in love with a young doctor, but is conflicted because he knows her tragic destiny.
A massive storm at sea serves as the backdrop for the final struggle to change what is written in the stars.
Prabhas plays the world-famous palmist Vikramaditya alongside Pooja Hegde.

title: Brochevarevarura
overview: Three lazy college students and their classmate Mithra plan a fake kidnapping to get money, but things get complicated when a real kidnapping takes place.
hints: Three lazy students who are struggling to pass their exams decide to help a classmate escape her strict father.
A parallel narrative tracks a young director trying to convince an actress to star in his debut film.
The students hatch a plan to stage a fake kidnapping to extract money from the girl's father.
The plan spirals out of control when a real gang of criminals enters the picture, causing a chaotic comedy of errors.
An acclaimed crime-comedy starring Sree Vishnu, Rahul Ramakrishna, and Priyadarshi as the 'R3 batch'.

title: Balagam
overview: Following the sudden death of a family patriarch in a Telangana village, the family members clash over petty issues, affecting the traditional 11-day funeral rituals.
hints: A family drama set in a rural village that begins with the sudden demise of the family's grandfather.
The grandfather's death brings long-simmering financial disputes and ego clashes among his children to the surface.
A crucial village custom regarding a bird eating the food offering becomes the central conflict of the story.
The family is humiliated as the bird repeatedly refuses to touch the food, indicating unresolved family conflicts.
A critically acclaimed Telangana-based hit film directed by comedian Venu Yeldandi, centered on the funeral rituals.

title: Color Photo
overview: In the late 1990s in Machilipatnam, a dark-skinned boy from a poor farming background falls in love with his classmate, facing severe prejudice from her brother and society.
hints: A tragic love story set in the late 1990s, focusing on two engineering college students from different backgrounds.
The protagonist is a humble, dark-skinned boy from a rural background who secretly loves his classmate.
Their relationship faces violent opposition from the girl's brother, an arrogant police officer who represents societal prejudice.
The film is known for its beautiful music and its deep commentary on colorism and class discrimination.
A National Award-winning tear-jerker starring Suhas and Chandini Chowdary.

title: Cinema Bandi
overview: An auto driver in a remote village finds a high-end camera left behind in his auto and decides to make a feature film starring his fellow villagers, hoping to bring water and power to their village.
hints: A group of simple villagers find a piece of high-end technology mistakenly left behind in a local transport vehicle.
They decide to use the device to make a movie, hoping the profits can bring water and electricity to their village.

They must complete the film before the actual owner of the equipment tracks them down.
An indie comedy carrying the memorable tagline: 'Everyone is a filmmaker at heart'.

title: Keedaa Cola
overview: A group of eccentric misfits find a cockroach inside a soft drink bottle and decide to sue the beverage company for millions, leading to a chaotic clash with a local politician's gang.
hints: A group of broke, eccentric friends stumble upon a manufacturing defect in a commercial product.
They attempt to launch a lawsuit and blackmail the company to get a massive financial payout.
They get pursued by a local political aspirant and his hot-headed brother who want the product for themselves.
The film features a hilarious, wheelchair-bound grandfather who has a strong addiction to sweet carbonated drinks.
Directed by Tharun Bhascker, this zany crime-comedy revolves around a cockroach inside a soft drink bottle.

title: MAD
actor: Sangeeth Shobhan, Narne Nithin, Ram Nithin
overview: Set in an engineering college and revolves around the antics of the students there, primarily the boys, who get a kick out of torturing the hostel warden.
hints: A youthful comedy set in an engineering college hostel, focusing on the antics of three close roommates.
They spend their time playing practical jokes, fighting other departments, and making their warden's life miserable.
A major mystery in the story is a mysterious girl who keeps calling one of the boys, causing jealousy and confusion.
The movie became a sleeper hit due to its non-stop, fast-paced slapstick humor and college-life nostalgia.
A college comedy starring Sangeeth Shobhan, Narne Nithin, and Ram Nithin.

title: Mathu Vadalara 2
overview: The two main protagonists from the first part are now working as special agents in a crime-fighting task force, but get framed for murder again.
hints: Two former delivery boys have managed to get jobs in a special government investigation unit.

The film features a running parody of exaggerated Indian TV serial dramas that plays in the background.
The zany crime-comedy sequel starring Sri Simha and Satya as special agents in the 'HE' team.

title: Gaami
overview: Shankar, an Aghora suffering from a rare disease where he faints upon human touch, embanks on a quest to the Himalayas to find the mystical Malipatra leaves.
hints: The story follows a man with a rare physical condition that makes him collapse whenever he is touched.

The film weaves three parallel stories: his journey, a secret laboratory doing human trials, and a prison escape.
Vishwak Sen plays the touch-phobic Aghora named Shankar in this epic adventure fantasy.

title: Yashoda
overview: Looking to save her sister, Yashoda, a desperate woman agrees to be a surrogate and move in to a plush facility - but nothing is as it seems.
hints: A woman from a poor family voluntarily registers at a high-end medical facility to earn money for her sister.

A parallel track investigates the suspicious deaths of wealthy celebrities and models linked to a beauty treatment.
The climax reveals a horrific illegal trade involving surrogate mothers and corporate greed.
Samantha Ruth Prabhu stars as the pregnant protagonist who is secretly an undercover cop.

title: V
overview: A celebrated cop faces his toughest challenge when a taunting serial killer begins targeting victims and leaving notes meant for him.
hints: A highly celebrated police officer receives a series of phone calls from a killer challenging him to a duel.

The killer is revealed to be a former decorated officer seeking revenge for the murder of his wife.
This thriller stars Nani in his 25th film as the anti-hero, alongside Sudheer Babu.

title: Virupaksha
overview: Set in a village named Rudravanam in 1990's, Surya along with his mother, visit there after a long time. Suddenly a series of mysterious deaths occur due to an occult practice.
hints: A young man travels to a remote village, only to find the locals living in fear of a strange occult practice.

The protagonist must investigate the village's dark history to find the source of the curse before his lover dies.
A supernatural horror thriller set in the village of Rudravanam, starring Sai Durgha Tej.

title: Ante... Sundaraniki!

hints: A young man raised in an extremely conservative, Brahmin household falls in love with a Christian girl.

title: Shyam Singha Roy
overview: An aspiring filmmaker is accused of plagiarizing the stories for his debut movie.
hints: An aspiring filmmaker is accused of plagiarizing the stories for his debut movie.

hints: A family faces complete destruction from a ruthless mining lord backed by a fake spiritual guru.

Chiranjeevi plays the titular lungi-clad protagonist alongside Ravi Teja in this action blockbuster.

overview: A brilliant detective in a homicide unit struggles with severe PTSD and panic attacks from a past tragedy.

Venkatesh and Varun Tej star as co-brother-in-laws in this blockbuster comedy entertainer.

title: Maharshi

Mahesh Babu plays Rishi Kumar, who learns that success is not a destination but a journey, in his milestone 25th film.

Mahesh Babu plays the ruthless and sharp Surya Bhai alongside Kajal Aggarwal in this Puri Jagannadh hit.

title: Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava

NTR Jr. plays Veera Raghava alongside Pooja Hegde in this emotional action drama directed by Trivikram.

Allu Arjun plays the dual roles of Duvvada Jagannadham and DJ in this high-energy mass film.

title: Oh! Baby

Samantha Ruth Prabhu plays the young avatar of Baby in this remake of the Korean film 'Miss Granny'.

An acclaimed multi-starrer anthological drama starring Allu Arjun, Anushka Shetty, and Manoj Manchu.

title: Naa Peru Surya - Naa Illu India

Allu Arjun plays the hot-headed soldier Surya in this patriotic action drama.

overview: A popular rock star suffers from integration disorder, which makes it hard for him to distinguish reality from imagination.
hints: A popular rock star suffers from integration disorder, which makes it hard for him to distinguish reality from imagination.

The investigation takes him to London and Belfast, uncovering a conspiracy related to high-yield golden rice seeds.

title: Nene Raju Nene Mantri
overview: A simple money lender enters local politics to seek revenge against a corrupt sarpanch who insulted his wife.
hints: A simple money lender enters local politics to seek revenge against a corrupt sarpanch who insulted his wife.

Nani plays Pencil Parthasarathy, the leader of the revenge gang, alongside Priyanka Arul Mohan.

He hires a carefree, ex-convict on parole as his personal caretaker because he appreciates his lack of pity.
The two form an unlikely, deep friendship, helping each other resolve personal family issues and find love.
The film is a beautiful exploration of disabled life, family bonds, and art, featuring a trip to Paris.
Nagarjuna Akkineni and Karthi star in this heartwarming adaptation of the French film 'The Intouchables'.

He stays at the landlord's house, managing his family conflicts and proving his integrity.
